summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed an 8-K reporting a September 23, 2026 securities purchase agreement with institutional investors for a registered direct offering of 1,765,420 common shares plus pre-funded warrants for up to 1,434,580 shares at $12.00 per share or warrant. Pre-funded warrants carry a $0.0001 exercise price and expire when exercised, with 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership blockers. Net proceeds are approximately $38.4 million for Greenland mining operations and working capital. Closing is expected on or about September 24, 2026, under an effective Form S-3 shelf. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
